# Using the ChromaMatter 0.9 Demo Data

[日本語](README_JA.md)

This folder contains a rights-cleared, Hi3D-generated multipart GLB and its
reference image. It intentionally contains **no generated or sample 3MF**.
Read [NOTICE_EN.md](NOTICE_EN.md) for rights and use conditions, and
[DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json](DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json) for the exact public payload
allowlist, sizes, and SHA-256 hashes.

**Generated by Hi3D**

## Files

- `Original AI model Color.glb` — multipart GLB with six source parts
- `Reference.jpg` — optional reference image

The package must contain only those two payload files, the four README/NOTICE
documents, and `DEMO_DATA_MANIFEST.json`. A `3MF` directory, a `.3mf` file,
validation sidecar, project file, or any other generated payload is not part of
this DemoData release.

## Short workflow

1. Start ChromaMatter. A fresh profile opens in **Flat Four** mode; **Full
   Spectrum** remains available when you explicitly select it.
2. Choose **Open OBJ / GLB** and open `Original AI model Color.glb`. If desired,
   choose **Open Reference** and open `Reference.jpg`.
3. Review the automatically proposed F1-F4 colours and the preview. Manual
   edits remain authoritative.
4. Under **Output Settings**, choose **Solidify** and wait for processing to
   finish before attempting export.
5. Export your own 3MF, open it **as a project** in Snapmaker Orca, and inspect
   geometry, materials, tool order, and the slice preview before printing.

## Before you begin

- The GLB names `RightLeg`, `LeftLeg`, `RightArm`, `LeftArm`, `Torso`, and
  `Head` are source segmentation labels and do not reliably identify the
  visible body regions. Inspect the geometry rather than relying on part names.
- **Important 0.9 limitation:** the single-model repair improvements do not
  resolve every multipart case. Multipart solidification remains
  input-dependent and may fail safely. Including the source GLB demonstrates
  the import and colour workflow; it is not proof that ChromaMatter will
  generate a valid, watertight, sliceable, or printable 3MF from this or any
  other model.
- Displayed and printed colours are not guaranteed to match. Use a comparison
  chart or a small test print with the same filaments and settings.
- Do not publish a generated 3MF or validation file merely because it was made
  from this DemoData. Review its contents and your redistribution rights first.
